notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Hey all, we are back with another update for FBG. Enjoy :)

[h2]Patchnotes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Three new sky layers: portal to another world, moons, and rainbows
[*] New background map layer: Towers
[*] Added a new menu (opens with C) with three new features which should be especially useful for streamers and for setting the mood of a room with your screen :)
[list]
[*] Automatic regeneration: set an interval and the app will recreate the scene after the interval has passed, continuing to do so until you tell it to stop or open the graphic settings. 
[*] Automatic camera rotation: have the cam rotate left or right with a given speed.
[*] Automatic day-night cycle: let time pass by automatically, at a given speed.
[/list]
[*] Added a button to regenerate random objects (e.g. tower roofs in Map 10 or forest trees in Map 12)
[*] Added buttons to regenerate and remove POIs (points of interests), e.g. buildings, statues etc.
[*] Fixed bug that prevented volumetric clouds from working
[*] Floating rocks are now correctly affected by the Rock Color
[*] Minor fixes in meshes and shaders.

Thanks for all the feedback guys! :D
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 - QoL, more customization, more content
notes.content:
Hey all :D

Update 1.3 brings lots of new customization options, improves the UI, and adds new content.

Feel free to give feedback on what features and content you want to see next.
Here are the exact patch notes:
[h2]New features
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added climate controls: you can switch between the default humid climate and a new arid desert climate, with an optional sandstorm effect
[*] Added option to manually set the rock type
[*] Trees, bushes, and grass can now be selected manually instead of the random re-roll
[*] Added option to change the post process effect and regulate its intensity
[*] Added option to change the fog color, sun light intensity, and the two random colors used to tint various assets throughout the scene, for example mushrooms and painted walls
[*] Grasses, weeds and roots are now automatically generated on suitable terrain. You can toggle this feature in the settings menu.
[*] Added reset buttons for certain options
[/list]
[h2]New Map Layers
[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Foreground: "Forest" [/h3]
Experiment with different tree types to make the most of this map type. Some vignette can also look nice.
[h3]Foreground: "Cave 2" [/h3]
With a large hole in the cave ceiling and a small lake (renamed the previous cave layer to "Cave 1"). Experiment with time of day, sun rotation and vignette to get cool results.
[h3]Background: “Near Mountains” [/h3]
For all your alpine endeavors (renamed the previous mountain layer to "Far Mountains")
[/list]
[h2]These creatures can now spawn in the map:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Deer couple
[*] Swamp Fly
[*] Golem
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes and improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sliders and dropdown menus now correctly update when you regenerate the world, showing the proper values that are currently in effect
[*] Improved the handling of options like bloom, fog, and gamma
[*] reworked the rock shaders with new textures, and they blend with the ground now for a more organic and realistic look
[*] Added lava snails to the “Lava Lakes” map layer
[*] Various shaders have been reworked to improve performance and visual fidelity
[*] Various assets have been resized and some bugs with their bounding boxes (causing flickering of the asset) were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Customization Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hey all :D
With the new update, we introduce a whole bunch of powerful customization options, as many of you have suggested. Have fun with FBG and keep the feedback coming![/h3]

[h1]Patch Notes
[/h1]

[h3]New settings[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Time of Day and Sun Rotation options
[*]     Buttons to regenerate the trees, bushes, and grass objects while keeping the rest of the map as is
[*]     Drop-down menus to select the foreground, background, floating and addon layeres while keeping the rest of the map as is
[*]     Button to toggle visibility of the new sky layer, more objects for that coming in future
[*]     Slider to control the saturation
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could freeze the app after pressing Q
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented random bushes from spawning properly
[*] Fixed a bug where some floating objects could intersect certain background layers[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] App starts in windowed fullscreen mode by default now, making it easier to take screenshots with the Windows snipping tool (Windows + Shift + S)
[*] Adjusted size of some assets
[/list]

notes.title: Graphic settings added
notes.content:
[h3]First of all, a big thanks to everyone who purchased FBG so far![/h3]
It's an absolute blast seeing all your screenshots.
We hope you like the app and will try to improve it going forward.

[h2]As a first update, we added a new graphic settings menu, accessible in the app with the Q key.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864376/677ecc5c1fd96656911b39b687516361ef83fae7.png[/img]

This will allow you to:
[list]
[*]manage window mode and VSync 
[*]change the color tint and gamma of the scene
[*]adjust the fog density
[*]regulate the light bloom
[/list]

These new settings should increase the versatility of the backgrounds. Try it out and feel free to share any feedback!

Cheers
Andi
